name: Book Word-Deck Comprehensible Input Story Generator

mentions.name: Book Word-Deck Comprehensible Input Story Generator
mentions.description: This tool generates comprehensible input stories for language learners composed of roughly 98% known words and 2% unknown words. Instead of rewriting existing stories, it uses vocabulary decks compiled from a target book's top ~1000 common but unique words; once the deck is completed, reading the target book becomes much easier. NumPy was being considered for implementation.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have a similar project, albiet pretty small. I want to generate comprehsnible input stories for the user say with 98% known words and 2% unknown words. Instead of rewriting stories though, I thought of having compiled list of books with say a book's top 1000 common but unique words, then you can add it to your desk and have those be generated in stories.
